name: Text-to-Speech Synthesis (Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice)
purpose: Synthesize speech audio from text using the Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice models (transformers / the qwen_tts package) under the speech venv. Resolves the TTS model + venv python from models.json; a Python worker (tts_infer.py) drives qwen_tts.Qwen3TTSModel.generate_custom_voice, and a PowerShell wrapper builds the contract envelope. Produces a 24 kHz mono PCM16 WAV (optionally re-encoded via audio.ingest). Populates confidence (synthesis-completeness heuristic) + model_provenance and routes failed/too-short synthesis to the review queue.

invocation.args_spec: Named params -Text <string> (required); -Speaker <name> (def Ryan); -Language <name> (def English); -Instruct <style>; -Seed <int> (def -1=random); -Dtype <bfloat16|float16|float32>; -SampleRate <hz|0=native 24000>; -Format <wav|mp3|flac|opus|ogg|m4a>; -MaxNewTokens <n>; -ConfidenceThreshold <0..1>; -Model <id>; -Registry/-PythonPath/-TtsInferPath/-AudioIngestPath/-PwshPath/-ReviewQueuePath <override>. OR -InputsJson '<json {text,speaker,language,instruct,seed,dtype,sample_rate,format,max_new_tokens,confidence_threshold,model,registry,python_path,tts_infer_path,audio_ingest_path,pwsh_path,review_queue_path}>'. Optional -ArtifactRoot, -InvocationId.
invocation.worker: tts_infer.py (run under the speech venv python)

inputs.name: speaker
inputs.description: Preset CustomVoice speaker. 0.6B set: Vivian, Serena, Uncle_Fu, Dylan, Eric (Chinese); Ryan, Aiden (English); Ono_Anna (Japanese); Sohee (Korean). Use a speaker in the text's native language for best results.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Spoken language name (English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, Italian).

inputs.name: instruct
inputs.description: Optional natural-language style instruction, e.g. 'Speak in a calm, clear tone.'

inputs.name: seed
inputs.description: Random seed for reproducibility; -1 = random (the model samples with do_sample=true).

inputs.name: sample_rate
inputs.description: Output sample rate in Hz; 0 keeps the native 24000. Non-native rates are produced via audio.ingest.

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Output format: wav (native) | mp3 | flac | opus | ogg | m4a (non-wav produced via audio.ingest).

inputs.name: max_new_tokens
inputs.description: Cap on generated codec tokens (0 = model default 8192).

inputs.name: confidence_threshold
inputs.description: Below this synthesis-completeness confidence, the synthesis is flagged to the review queue.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: TTS model id in models.json (type=tts, engine=transformers). Also tts.strong.qwen3-1p7b.

executables: ffmpeg>=6 (via audio.ingest, only for non-wav/non-24k output)
